**A tidier stream menu and clearer stats.** Changes from launch feedback.

- The floating menu button is smaller and see-through until you touch it.
- Menu items that switch something on or off (Stats, Mouse mode, Keyboard, Pan and zoom, Touch sensitivity, On-screen controller, Menu button) now show a small switch, and tapping them keeps the menu open.
- The menu header shows the game's cover art.
- Desktop and games without cover art get a Starwire tile instead of a plain coloured block.
- The Lite stats line uses plain words: data rate, ping, decode time, dropped frames and FPS.
- You can send your microphone to the PC (**Settings → Sound & vibration**). This only works if the PC runs [logabell's Apollo build](https://github.com/logabell/apollo-microphone/releases). Vibepollo, Sunshine and regular Apollo can't receive it yet. Thanks to logabell for the microphone code.

### Install
Download **Starwire-0.1.3.apk** below and open it. It installs over 0.1.2 and keeps your pairing and settings.

GPL-3.0.
